pire.p: [ nipātapuda ] (bya) Google Translate (1) One who is not cherished. (2) Apa-kun-satta. (3) In addition.

P: Pire，at Vin．IV，139 is to be separated （cara pi re get away with you），both pi and re acting as part．of exclamation．The C．expln （p．362） by “pire （Voc．?）=para，amāmaka” is an artificial construction．（Page 460）
DOP: pire ( related by cts to para, but prob. to be read as pi re); Vin IV 139, 3 (evaṃ ca pana bhikkhave nāsetabbo … cara pire vinassā ti; Sp 871, 6 : pire ti para amāmaka; Sp-ṭ [ Be ] III 89, 12 foll.: pire ti nipātapadaṃ, sambodhane vattamānaṃ parasaddena samānatthaṃ vadantī ti āha para amāmakā ti … pire ti vā parato ti iminā samānatthaṃ nipātapadaṃ, tasmā cara pire ti parato gaccha); M II 108, 1 (cara pire Mallike vinassā ti; Ps III 344, 20 foll.: apehi amhākaṃ pare anajjhattikabhūte ti attho, atha vā care pire ti parato gaccha, mā idha tiṭṭhā ti pi attho); Sp 582, 23 (cara pire vinassā ti daṇḍakammaṃ karonti, ayaṃ daṇḍakammanāsanā).
